slo_title: Explain and implement priority scheduling with suitable examples

mcq.q: In Round Robin scheduling, what happens when a process exhausts its time quantum?

options.B: It goes to the end of the ready queue
options.C: It moves to the blocked state
options.D: It runs until the CPU is free

mcq.answer_text: It goes to the end of the ready queue

mcq.q: In Preemptive Priority Scheduling, when does a process get preempted?

options.A: If a process with lower priority arrives
options.B: If a process with higher priority arrives

mcq.answer_text: If a process with higher priority arrives
